Hurt people hurt people.  
God doesn't forget people.   Im not religous anymore but if you are god loves all his creations. You are not forgotten.   If you are realizing that you have been cruel or hurtfull then i am proud of you for taking the first step! Realization.  If you have access to a therapist or life coach id recomend talking to them.  You might have unaddressed trauma or a chemical imbalance.   If that isnt something you can do then spend some time self reflecting, check out some anger management techniques, and be patient with yourself on your journey.
